name: Jellyfin Featured
overview: A Netflix-style featured-content carousel for the Jellyfin Web home page.
description: Adds a configurable featured-content carousel with curated favourites, collections, recent releases, random picks, hero layouts, and local background trailers to Jellyfin Web.
